layouts: Flat and 100-files-per-folder nested layouts; deep40 distributes files evenly along a 40-directory single-child chain, with special entries and empty directory at its deepest leaf
memory_method: Separate fresh Python-process peak RSS/physical footprint from time -lp. Includes interpreter, import and child count/hash checks; excludes parent runner. Same startup for every method. Wrapper times are diagnostics, not API timing results or standalone C-engine memory.
native_origin: Installed runtime outside source checkout; memory children verify the same binary hash
timing: Python API wall and process CPU time; native implementations; warm OS cache; no process startup

comparison_method.baseline: POSIX readdir/fstatat scanner in the same installed native extension; not a separate Apple command.
comparison_method.timing: Medians of 11 API calls after two warmup rounds, with all 117 timing rows retained. Wall/process CPU exclude Python startup.
comparison_method.memory: Three fresh Python children per method/layout; 27 separate rows. Peak RSS and physical footprint include interpreter, imports and count/hash validation. They are not standalone native-engine memory.
comparison_method.formulas: Difference = candidate median minus POSIX median; percent change = 100 * difference / POSIX median; ratio = POSIX median / candidate median. Negative differences and ratios above 1 favor the candidate.
comparison_method.units: Time is seconds; memory is bytes. KiB = 1024 bytes; MiB = 1048576 bytes.
comparison_method.ranges: Memory ranges are observed minima/maxima of only three samples, not confidence intervals. The flat bulk median RSS is one 16 KiB page below POSIX, within overlapping observed ranges; this does not establish a memory reduction beyond variation.
comparison_method.scope: These synthetic flat, nested and 40-directory-chain fixtures do not establish a universal filesystem improvement.
comparison_method.cpu_utilization: Per-sample API process cpu_s / wall_s, summarized as median/min/max after excluding warmups. Process CPU includes native threads and the same Python call overhead; API timing excludes interpreter startup. These ratios measure average occupied CPU cores over each scan call, not machine-wide utilization or peak load. Lower CPU work does not necessarily mean lower average load; peak utilization is unmeasured.

export_provenance.preservation: All original fields, sample order, measurements, count validations and hashes are unchanged.
export_provenance.path_sanitization: No personal local paths were present.

release_applicability.scope: The final wheel changes Python interruption diagnostics to honor --json and refreshes README metadata. Native CLI operations, the scanner extension and imported workspace API modules are byte-identical to the measured package. None of the measured paths executes the Python dispatcher; file-command --version preflight uses it outside measurement. Original measurement fingerprints are retained. The revised interruption diagnostic was regression-tested, not benchmarked.
